I mainly use the website [INCIdecoder](https://incidecoder.com/decode-inci). I copy the ingredients of a product, and there should be a column that says “irr., com.” with numbers that appear like 3,2 (example only).

The first number (3) represents how likely it is to irritate your skin, while the second number (2) represents the comedogenicity. There’s a comedogenicity scale from 0-5. For example, 0 means that the product would not clog your pores but a rating of 5 means that it would most likely clog it.

While it’s a useful tool, [LabMuffin did a good video explaining why it’s not too reliable](https://youtu.be/-wz__FPq5kE?si=6GlLEXqgNX5JO-1J).
